qa.author: cit-ridgelinerose
qa.body: FDEQ — the Pigeon River dam relicensing: will the new license set an enforceable minimum in-stream flow and fish passage, or is that still 'under study'? And when does the comment window actually close?

qa.author: ag-fdeq
qa.body: The draft license includes a proposed minimum in-stream flow tied to the same gauge data the Valley Water Rights Act (HB-09) would use; fish passage is in the draft, not deferred. The public comment window is open through the posted closing date on this page, and comments citing specific flow figures carry the most weight in the record.

qa.author: cit-farmbureaufran
qa.body: Does the relicensing touch agricultural withdrawals upstream, or is that strictly an HB-09 question? I don't want to comment in the wrong place and have it ignored.

qa.author: ag-fdeq
qa.body: The license governs dam operations, not withdrawal allocations — those sit with HB-09 at the Assembly. But the two share the same flow record, so a comment here about drought-year flows is read alongside the HB-09 deliberation. Filing in both is not redundant; it's the thorough thing to do.
